items.text: WE WON! The Supreme Court just BLOCKED Biden's illegal vaccine mandate for workers at large businesses. It's a great day for COMMON SENSE, but I will not stop fighting for our healthcare heroes who were left out of this decision!

I am PROUD to co-sponsor @RepJeffDuncan's Congressional Review Act. The Supreme Court let the vaccine mandate for healthcare HEROES go into effect, so Congress MUST act! We already have a healthcare worker shortage- things WILL get worse if Congress doesn't block Biden's mandate.

I've joined @RepChipRoy in pledging NOT to vote for vaccine mandate funding later this month! We the PEOPLE don't need the federal government making healthcare decisions for us and we DEFINITELY don't need to waste taxpayer money on politicians’ unprecedented power grab.

Critical Access Hospitals are the backbone of rural healthcare! I want to thank the team at Collingsworth General Hospital for having me out to tour the hospital and for keeping me up to date on issues I can help with in Congress. Rural America won’t be left behind on my watch! https://t.co/CXTKfq3WI3

.@ApolloMedFlight is doing incredible, lifesaving work to help patients during medical emergencies in Texas and beyond. I’m proud to say they’re headquartered right here in Amarillo! https://t.co/V46LAOqOCp

WELCOME to Wichita Falls, Momentum Specialty Surgery Center!! Thank you for having me at your grand opening. Surgery centers provide EXCELLENT care at a lower cost to patients, something that's CRITICAL to the future of healthcare in our country! #TX13 https://t.co/MPsBV3J694

@SteveScalise is an absolute warrior. Please join me in praying for my friend and colleague to receive additional strength as he undergoes treatments for his recent diagnosis.

Thank you @RiceSpearman of @TTUHSC for meeting with me to champion the collaboration between Pampa, TX and TTUHSC Infant Risk Center to improve maternal health services in Pampa and the surrounding areas. A HUGE win for rural healthcare in TX-13! https://t.co/ERNvzvizfR

Preventing more rural hospitals from being forced to close their doors is imperative. TX-13 relies on these hospitals and I will ALWAYS be committed to developing the medical infrastructure of rural communities who DESERVE the BEST!

Congratulations to BSA Health System in Amarillo for being rated one of the nation's top 30 hospitals for patient experience! The invaluable impact and compassionate care BSA offers to the Panhandle is incredible. Here's to continued excellence and keep up the great work! https://t.co/APlI5hqaDK

Congratulations to Childress Regional Medical Center, Nocona General Hospital, Seymour Hospital, and Wilbarger General Hospital for being named the Top 100 Rural & Community Hospitals of 2024!
 
A special shoutout to Moore County Hospital District for being named a Top 100 Critical Access Hospitals of 2024! 

I'm proud to represent so many OUTSTANDING rural hospitals in Texas' 13th Congressional District, and thank you to all the doctors, nurses, and staff who work hard to provide the BEST care to our communities!

My provision to strengthen rural hospitals was included in the @HouseAgGOP passed Farm Bill! 

I will do everything I can to help prevent rural hospitals from shutting their doors and work to ensure these communities have access to quality care! https://t.co/WU3L0kd5I5

The Water Resources Development Act (WRDA) approved by @TransportGOP includes MAJOR WINS for TX-13 water infrastructure! 

- $38M for Amarillo for water and wastewater infrastructure, including stormwater management and water storage and treatment systems 
- $5M for Clarendon for water infrastructure, including water storage 
- $7M for Runaway Bay for water and wastewater infrastructure, including stormwater management and water storage and treatment systems

Under NO circumstances should Americans become subjects of the World Health Organization!

I joined my colleagues today to express STRONG opposition to efforts now underway by the Biden-Harris admin, the CCP, the United Nations, and the World Economic Forum that would surrender US Sovereignty to the unaccountable bureaucrats at the WHO.

Thank you to @SteveDaines for introducing the companion resolution in the U.S. Senate! More below: https://t.co/yPnJ4sB4dE

This bill provides the tools needed to prevent closures and continue delivering critical healthcare in rural America.  https://t.co/ktuaDAwvdG
